g.text: Target curator-run composes and refuses on pin mismatch; harness turns
Runs tool calls inside the remote agent's OS user
Seeds from the exact base SHA, exports patch
Reads Playbook.json at the default-branch head
Validates and resolves the closure and role skills
Asks whether a version is confirmed or covered
Reads role bindings, pins and slots
Launches the role with the spawn key
Publishes goal revisions, receives outcome proposals
spawn = dispatch(LaunchRequest); RUN-* attached by reconciliation
Checks the spawn grant and attenuation-only delegation
Creates and removes OS users, homes and firewall rules through the privileged helper
Registers the new UID to its identity path; requests revocation at retire
Launches as the new OS user
Execs the harness as the agent's OS user
Asks for signatures of its outbound messages; the key never leaves the keeper
Signs outbound items on behalf of the posting agent
Resolves the credential source_ref at exec: env token, helper, or shared file
Relays the vendor's re-login flow and lease approvals
Kernel firewall per UID admits only the message broker and the egress proxy
Remote agents receive tasks through the mailbox like local ones
Confirms the public root once at installation
Talks to keepers in product spaces
Signs mandates, grants and authoritative envelopes
Lists, parks, restarts; R55 binary swap in the maintenance slot
Confirms flow versions, acts in human-owned states
Asks for one plan (compose-only); compares expect_pin
Resolves the role profile (sole fragment reader)

Compare-only pin answer on resume; new plan only for rebuild
Rechecks gates before exec; holds the transferred lease
